options.label: C
options.text: Rash and loss of taste are less frequent

questions.solutionHtml:

questions.stem: Following are uses of ACE inhibitors except:
questions.solutionHtml:
Diabetic Neuropathy

Advantages of Enalapril over captopril:

  • More potent
  • Longer half life – OD (5-20 mg OD)
  • Absorption not affected by food
  • Rash and loss of taste are less frequent
  • Onset of action is slower (due to need for conversion to active metabolite), less liable to cause abrupt first dose hypotension
  • Less side effects

questions.stem: A patient with gout needs to be started on an ARB, which one of them is best to this patient?
questions.solutionHtml:
Losartan

Angiotensin Receptor blocker which lowers uric acid levels is Losartan
Losartan has mild probenecid like uricosuric action so, may be preferred in patient with gout and HTN
